title: I haven’t stopped thinking about English at @Roundabout Theatre Compa...
transcript: Have you ever thought about how much of your identity is tied to the language that you speak? That's the question that kept running through my mind while watching English, the 2023 Pulitzer Prize winning play that is just started previews at roundabout. The play by Sanaz Toosi follows four students in Iran. They are taking a six week English course as they study for the TOEFL exam. The show is hilarious, like laugh out loud funny, and so deeply relatable if you've ever tried to learn a second language. But it's also incredibly heartfelt and emotional because it's not just about learning English. It's about identity and community and about how learning a new language can expand your world but also make you feel completely lost. It really opened my eyes to the bravery of people who moved to a country where the native language is not their own. It feels so timely and relevant, and it's a show I think everyone should see if you're under the age of 40. Roundabout has one of my favorite theater programs, hip tics. You can sign up for free and get access to 30 dollar tickets to all roundabout shows, including English. Don't miss this one.
